personal.name: Samir Randeriya
personal.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
personal.bio: I am a Senior Full Stack Developer with around 5 Years of experience in the Sphere of SaaS, Enterprise Applications, and Web Solutions Development. I have extensive knowledge and experience of ReactJS, Next.js, Laravel, PHP, Node.js, TypeScript, REST API, databases, etc. My main skills are associated with project development, requirements definition, coding, architectural design, and deployment of solutions. In addition, I have years of experience in mentoring other developers and working with International clients. I aim to provide cost-effective solutions by building top-notch products that solve real-world problems, scale effectively, and are easy to maintain.

hero.description: I build secure, scalable SaaS and enterprise applications using React.js, Next.js, Laravel, Node.js, and REST APIs. I handle projects end-to-end, from requirements and architecture to development, testing, and deployment.
